description: Q_β Stage-C: tests the trivial-kernel hypothesis that the c_k ladder IS the Hahn–Exton q-Bessel family for some single order ν, normalization-free via ratios, at the substrate anchor q₀ (forbidden-gap analysis) and the q=1 classical-Bessel shadow (pin-ν-predict-next). data.verdict: REFUTED — trivial-kernel Hahn–Exton identification excluded at BOTH levels. Level A: r_2^emp = +2.0000 lies in the structurally forbidden gap (0, 3.3521) of the Hahn–Exton ratio at q₀ — reproducing it would require q^(ν+3) = -0.6760 < 0, impossible for real ν. Level B: pinning ν = -3.1667 from the q=1 shadow r_2 and predicting r_3 gives -0.3000 vs empirical +0.4858 (sign-flipped, rel err -161.8%). CONCLUSION: the bare Hahn–Exton ratio is NOT the Q_β kernel — a NON-trivial kernel R(q,ξ) is required (consistent with the OPEN-keystone status in the registry). Recorded as refuted class C14 (trivial-kernel Hahn–Exton identification). No c_k value proposed, no fit.
